text: Efficiency Capital Inc. (EC) has requested that Toronto Atmospheric Fund enter into an Energy Savings Performance Agreement (ESPA) contract with Scarborough Heights Co-op, located at 90 Burrows Hall Boulevard, Scarborough, to provide retrofit financing in the amount of $352,946 gross, $249,742 net of HST, incentives. The Co-op will contribute an additional $244,589 towards the retrofit. The financing will be under the terms of the Warehouse Facility established for Efficiency Capital, whereby Efficiency Capital Inc. takes out Toronto Atmospheric Fund financing within two years; it will remain a Toronto Atmospheric Fund investment until the arrangement with Efficiency Capital Inc. is updated. The project is projected to reduce the building's greenhouse gas emissions by 18 percent (69 tonnes per year).

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment, structured as an Energy Savings Performance Agreement, and under the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Warehouse Facility for Efficiency Capital, of up $352,946 gross and $249,742 net of HST and incentives, for the retrofit of Scarborough Heights Co-operative, to be executed via Toronto Atmospheric Fund's designee, Efficiency Capital Corp. 2. Authorized the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 16, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing, Toronto Atmospheric Fund following the closing of any purchase transaction.
